title: First 5-minute 'Zero Config' Setup Tour for Console (micro-walkthroughs + skip-to-later)
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design and validate a 'zero config' micro-walkthrough that gets engineers and platform teams to a meaningful first success in under five minutes. The flow is modular: a lightweight initial tour anchored to console elements, optional seeded templates, and a persistent 'skip / resume later' affordance. Success metrics: time-to-first-query <= 5 min, 70% opt-in completion rate for new workspaces, reduce help-desk tickets about 'where to start' by 40%.
comments: 2026-02-10 — Ava M: Kickoff and problem framing. Observed frequent first-run drop-offs in onboarding funnel; customers ask 'where do I put my key' and 'how to try a sample call'. Hypothesis: micro-walkthrough + seeded example projects will reduce drop-off.

2026-02-12 — Liam C: Drafted three patterns: (A) full-screen wizard, (B) anchored micro-walkthroughs, (C) template-first seeded project. Prefers (B) for lowest engineering lift and best contextual help. Decided to prototype (B) + an opt-in 'seed project' card.

2026-02-15 — Research: 6 usability sessions with external developers. Results: micro-walkthroughs scored higher for perceived control; 4/6 completed a sample API call within 3 minutes. Key friction: unclear where to find API key; we added a one-click reveal in header.

2026-02-17 — Design: Figma prototype v1 completed with 7 micro-pillows anchored to header, model selector, seed project card, and cost preview. Prototype link above. Visual treatment uses low-contrast overlay + accent CTAs to avoid blocking power users.

2026-02-18 — Engineering feedback (ENG-assign): suggested prefer feature-flag rollout and telemetry gating; flagged that onboarding state should be stored server-side for Dedicated customers. Added parents: ENG-81290 for server-side state work.

2026-02-19 — Accessibility review: ensured keyboard focus order for tour anchors, added ARIA role alerts for each step, and tested with screen reader. Minor tweak: increase focus ring contrast on action buttons.

2026-02-20 — Product review (PM Ana R): Requested a low-friction 'skip and never show again' option and a lightweight 'replay tour' action in workspace settings. Also requested opt-in analytics events to measure completion and step drop-offs.

2026-02-22 — Prototype test run (internal): 18 teammates across Growth, SE, and Solutions tried the tour. Completion rate 78% with median time = 3:40. Noted confusion around 'seed project' terminology — changed label to 'Starter template'.

2026-02-23 — Design notes for dev handoff: include copy variations for A/B test (short vs. verbose), provide image assets at 2x/3x, and a CSS spec for overlay z-index and motion duration. Link to PR for initial implementation above.

2026-02-23 — Next steps: ship behind feature flag, instrument events (tour_shown, step_viewed, step_completed, tour_completed, tour_dismissed), run 2-week pilot on new orgs, analyze funnel and help-ticket deltas. Follow-up ticket: DES-761235 for copy localization and microcopy polish.
